items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled OUT for Sunday vs Jaguars, along with Tank Dell (knee) and Jalen Pitre.
items.implication: Full backfield to remaining RBs; Marks saw 98% snaps last week in his absence.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down work consolidates to backup RBs in London matchup.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled out for Week 6 (and indefinitely) due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; Tanner McKee to start. Health priority, treatment course TBD (possible blood thinners).
items.why: Movement in small superficial clot after initial clearance for London game; doctors prioritize safety.
items.implication: Eagles offense shifts to McKee; Hurts fantasy value zero short-term, monitor multi-week absence risk.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for Eagles pass-catchers like Goedert if volume holds; McKee streamer in 2QB.

items.text: Patriots announced TreVeyon Henderson will miss multiple weeks (high ankle). In Week 1 absence Rhamondre Stevenson played 85% snaps/23 touches; averages 16.3 PPG on 15+ touches since 2024. Borderline RB1 while Henderson out.
items.why: High ankle sprain multi-week; clear volume precedent for Stevenson.
items.implication: Stevenson massive upgrade to RB1 range; Henderson stash only.
items.opportunity: Stevenson 80%+ snaps, 20+ touches, goal-line work vs NYJ.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return with shoulder injury mid-TNF vs SEA, then returned to the game.
items.why: Shoulder issue but cleared to return same game.
items.implication: Avoided multi-game absence; usage may be monitored post-game.
items.opportunity: No immediate reverse of beneficiaries; full role retained if healthy.
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle for Week 6 due to matchup/volume issues.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore did not practice for the second straight day due to shoulder injury.
items.implication: Status for Sunday vs LV in doubt; monitor Friday report.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to other Bills WRs if limited or out.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love did not practice for the second straight day due to ankle injury.
items.implication: Questionable/GTD risk for Week 6; rookies often slow recoveries.
items.opportunity: ARI RB depth chart shifts if out; monitor for handcuff elevation.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley no practice again Thursday (hamstring context); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited. Pair with Hurts out creates major PHI uncertainty vs CAR.
items.why: Continued absence from practice; Smith progress to limited.
items.implication: Barkley likely OUT or GTD; Smith trending better for availability.
items.opportunity: If Barkley OUT, remaining PHI RBs and pass game (Goedert elevated) see role expansion under McKee.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again Thursday due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Elevated risk of missing or limited vs LAC; GTD likely.
items.opportunity: Worthy/others see target share bump if out or limited.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson officially did not practice again Thursday (ankle).
items.why: Ankle sprain context; consecutive missed practices.
items.implication: Shot to play but rushing limited if active; status key for BAL offense.
items.opportunity: If out, Huntley/backup elevates; Henry/ Flowers still viable but ceiling down.

items.text: RB snaps in two full games since Breece Hall injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0. Hall remains week-to-week, no practice.
items.why: Clear hierarchy with Allen dominating snaps/usage while Hall week-to-week.
items.implication: Allen is the clear lead back and must-start while Hall out; Davis change-of-pace only.
items.opportunity: Allen 90%+ snap share, high carries/routes; handcuff locked in.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty said he is feeling great and this is the best he’s felt this season; positive update ahead of Bills matchup.
items.why: Player comments on ankle/foot feeling best of season.
items.implication: Likely full go; reverse any prior sit signals.
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry share expected; no handcuff elevation needed.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Mike Evans as WR4 this week vs Commanders secondary; season-high 36% target share last week, and with Deebo out multi-weeks the depth is thin (Cooks etc.).
items.why: Elite matchup vs WSH + elevated target share with Deebo sidelined multi-weeks; thin WR depth behind.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; volume locked in.
items.opportunity: High target share, red-zone potential in favorable spot.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI, elite recent usage), Javonte Williams (RB8 @ GB, goal-line role), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ, volume). All face run-leaking defenses.
items.why: Volume + matchup vs leaky run Ds; Kyren usage elite, Javonte GL, Stevenson post-Henderson.
items.opportunity: Carries, red-zone, snap shares elevated in positive game scripts.

items.text: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane (rookie) expected back to practice 4 weeks post-wrist surgery; has shot to play this weekend. Elite 6.4 YPP offense even with Lamar missing snaps; camp buzz suggested Bateman ice potential.
items.why: Recovery timeline + HC comments + elite offense efficiency + pre-injury buzz.
items.implication: Immediate roster/watch-list candidate; potential target share in high-YPP attack.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets available if active; monitor practice-to-active progression.
